name: HouseCanary
tagline: AI-powered property valuation and real estate analytics.
description: HouseCanary is a property valuation and analytics platform covering 136M+ U.S. properties. It uses machine learning — including image recognition that reads home condition from photos — to produce automated valuations (AVMs), comparables, market forecasts, and portfolio monitoring, plus CanaryAI, a generative AI assistant. It serves mortgage lenders, single-family-rental investors, REITs, and agents through an API and web products.
insight: Operates as a licensed real-estate brokerage in multiple states in addition to selling its valuation data and AVMs.
edge: Pairs a lender-grade AVM with photo-based condition scoring and a generative assistant (CanaryAI) over 136M+ properties.
